headline: 4 contract types catalogued from audits (Vault, WithdrawVault, LPToken, Utils); 0 deployed addresses confirmed on-chain; BTW governance token located on BSC from explorer search snippet only.

No verified Vault/WithdrawVault/LPToken addresses surfaced via explorer name-tag.

docs.bitway.com fetched; no dedicated 'deployed contracts' page was found. The docs describe the staking flow and BNB Chain deployment but do not list deployed addresses. protocol_metadata.deployed_contracts_doc set to null.

BlockSec audit (Oct 27 2025) fetched in full: repo https://github.com/bitwaylabs/bitway-earn at commit ed615c130ff4ebe1bea5e48c2e0acbf94ab42ad8; contracts in scope: Vault.sol, WithdrawVault.sol, LPToken.sol, utils.sol. No deployed addresses listed in the audit. Salus BitwayEarn audit (Oct 20 2025) fetched in full: same commit ed615c1, same four contracts. No deployed addresses. Salus Token audit PDF not fetched this run.

GitHub org bitwaylabs confirmed active via search; repo bitwaylabs/bitway-earn confirmed. Direct fetch of github.com/bitwaylabs/bitway-earn was rejected by the fetch allowlist (URL had not appeared in user messages or prior results verbatim). No broadcast/hardhat-deploy artifacts could be read. Commit ed615c1 pinned from both audits.

Protocol.chains = Binance only. DeFiLlama confirms BSC-only TVL ($59.5M). Salus audit states 'Ethereum Blockchain and BSC Blockchain' as platforms but DeFiLlama shows zero non-BSC TVL; may indicate Ethereum deployment was planned but not live. No Ethereum name-tag addresses found.
No factory contract identified in audits or docs. The Vault contract supports multiple tokens via addSupportedToken() admin function, not a factory pattern. No child enumeration applicable.

Role taxonomy from audits: Vault and WithdrawVault each hold DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (admin), PAUSER_ROLE (admin), BOT_ROLE (bot), plus a custodian address. LPToken has an admin role and a minter/vault reference. Roles are not assigned to identified multisig/EOA addresses — actor classes unknown pending on-chain reads.

BTW token on BSC (0x444045b0ee1ee319a660a5e3d604ca0ffa35acaa) appeared in a BscScan search snippet with the label 'Bitway Token (BTW)' — recorded in admin_addresses with role 'token' but actor_class unknown as the address page was not directly fetched this run. All other contract addresses (Vault, WithdrawVault, LPToken instances) were not discoverable on-chain this run.

rationale.verdict: Discovery walk covered website, two audit PDFs, DeFiLlama, and docs.bitway.com. Four contract types (Vault, WithdrawVault, LPToken, Utils) were identified from audits with pinned commit ed615c1 but no deployed BSC addresses were confirmed via on-chain fetch. One candidate address (0x095418a82bc2439703b69fbe1210824f2247d77c) and BTW token address (0x444045b0ee1ee319a660a5e3d604ca0ffa35acaa) surfaced from BscScan search snippets only; their roles could not be confirmed without a direct block-explorer fetch.

evidence.shows: BlockSec audit of Bitway Earn (Oct 27 2025): repo https://github.com/bitwaylabs/bitway-earn at commit ed615c130ff4ebe1bea5e48c2e0acbf94ab42ad8; contracts Vault.sol, WithdrawVault.sol, LPToken.sol, utils.sol in scope; roles DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, PAUSER_ROLE, BOT_ROLE, custodian confirmed; emergencyWithdraw function on Vault and WithdrawVault identified.

Salus Security audit of Bitway Labs / Bitway Earn (Oct 20 2025): repo https://github.com/bitwaylabs/bitway-earn at commit ed615c1; platform stated as Ethereum + BSC; files Vault.sol, WithdrawVault.sol, LPToken.sol, utils.sol with SHA-1 hashes; centralization risk, PAUSER_ROLE retention bug, missing token-removal function, custodian transfer bypass on pause noted.
Official Bitway website confirms protocol exists; meta description: 'Bitway is a capital gateway connecting on-chain liquidity with global markets'.

Official docs confirm Bitway Earn deployed on BNB Chain; users stake USDT/USDC and receive voucher tokens (e.g. bwUSDT); most assets sent to custodial accounts (multi-sig wallets, regulated CEXs, third-party custodians); two withdrawal modes: Standard Unstake (~7 days) and Flash Unstake (instant); yield settled into vault periodically.

DeFiLlama confirms: TVL $59.5M all on BSC; category Basis Trading; GitHub https://github.com/bitwaylabs; BTW token; 4 pools tracked averaging 8.75% APY; seed raise $4.44M from TRON DAO and HTX Ventures Jan 2026.

BscScan search snippet shows token contract 0x444045b0ee1ee319a660a5e3d604ca0ffa35acaa labelled 'Bitway Token (BTW)' on BSC; description: 'Bitway is the internet capital gateway that connects on-chain liquidity with global opportunities'. protocol_metadata.about: Bitway Earn is an on-chain asset management product deployed on BNB Chain where users stake ERC-20 tokens (USDT, USDC) into a Vault contract and receive non-fungible LP voucher tokens (e.g. bwUSDT) representing their share plus accrued yield. Most deposited assets are transferred off-chain to custodial accounts on Binance and other institutions to execute market-neutral basis-trading strategies, while a small liquidity reserve remains on-chain to serve Standard Unstake (~7 days) and Flash Unstake (instant, with penalty) requests. The protocol is operated by Bitway Labs and uses privileged roles (DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, BOT_ROLE, custodian) to manage reward rates, process custodian transfers, pause the system, and perform emergency withdrawals.
